pages.article_html:
Question And Answer

Level 29 · Adventuring · Mekalia

Objectives

Purchase the arcane pliers Ardalan needs to repair the unicorn teleporter, and bring them to Ardalan at the Upper Upside Camp in Mekalia. The vendor Azeeta Shaheen should have the pliers available at Shaheen's Traveling Mercantile to the south. - Arcane Pliers (0/1)

Description

Ardalan says, "I would like to restore this device to working order. It would be a challenge worthy of my wit." "Sadly, it would prove too much of a challenge to my coin purse." "Do you have the coin necessary to purchase a pair of arcane pliers? I'll need them to repair this device." "Azeeta Shaheen should have the pliers for sale. Her mercantile tent is almost due south of here, down in the desert."

What they say

On offering it

Ardalan
I would like to restore this device to working order. It would be a challenge worthy of my wit. Sadly, it would prove too much of a challenge to my coin purse. Do you have the coin necessary to purchase a pair of arcane pliers? I'll need them to repair this device. Azeeta Shaheen should have the pliers for sale. Her mercantile tent is almost due south of here, down in the desert.

Recorded by quest description.

Notes

The price of the Arcane Pliers are 10 gold. Azeeta Shaheen is located in the chunk to the south in the southwest corner.

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

Objectives as recorded by fandom

Arcane Pliers (1) Purchase the arcane pliers Ardalan needs to repair the unicorn teleporter, and bring them to Ardalan at the Upper Upside Camp in Mekalia. The vendor Azeeta Shaheen should have the pliers available at Shaeheen's Traveling Mercantile to the south.

findings.observation: The primary objective directs purchasing Arcane Pliers and bringing them to Ardalan at Upper Upside Camp in Mekalia. Tracker prints Arcane Pliers (0/1); the fandom-attributed account prints Arcane Pliers (1). Preserve a requested count of one without inferring item consumption or completion scripts.

Notes explicitly state a price of 10 gold for Arcane Pliers. This agrees with the vgwalkthroughs-attributed later-chain account preserved in the prior A Marvelous Plan review. It is an attributed purchase cost, not a monetary reward, verified live merchant inventory, or independent historical corroboration.

Objective and dialogue identify vendor Azeeta Shaheen to the south, down in the desert. Notes describe the chunk to the south and southwest corner. Primary objective spells the mercantile Shaheen; the fandom-attributed objective spells it Shaeheen. No exact vendor coordinates or canonical merchant ID are established.

Starts with prints Ardalan. Location prints 50070, 84493, 44118 in Mekalia (-11, -9). Objective names Ardalan at Upper Upside Camp as delivery contact. Preserve the page-local coordinate association without promoting it to verified spawn coordinates or inferring axis units. No separate Hand in to field is printed.

Header prints Level 29 and Adventuring. Series is Unicorn; Previous is A Marvelous Plan and Next is Finding Aynien. Previous agrees with that prior page Next Question And Answer. These are navigation observations, not proof of enforced prerequisites or minimum eligibility.

No Rewards section or explicit reward amount appears in the cached article. Repair dialogue describes intended use of the pliers, not a verified repair script or rewarded teleporter. The prior walkthrough continues into device use and Aynien; those later steps are not this page tracker.
